Markus / Lauren — forwarding Acero's request. They want a temporary invoicing path while their PO is issued (3–4 weeks). They provided W9 and SOC2 summary; see attachments.

High level ask from Acero: allow invoice-only onboarding for a timeboxed pilot, capped at $12,000, with requirement to transition to standard PO within 30 days of first invoice. They’re fine with a short SOW and a DocuSign acknowledgement that they’ll provide a PO once internal approvals finish.

Can procurement/finance sign off on a conditional exception or do we need VP approval? If we can approve conditionally, what controls do you want (credit cap, payment terms, SLA for PO delivery)?

Connor

Connor — thanks for the heads up. Quick take: procurement is generally strict on PO requirement, but we do have an established temporary-invoice policy for low-risk pilots with limited exposure. Conditions we typically require:

- Evidence of entity (W9) and SOC2 summary (they provided both).
- A capped spend — $12k seems reasonable for a 6-week pilot; finance prefers an amount that won't require credit checks.
- Net-30 payment terms with automatic suspension if invoices exceed the cap.
- A signed one-page acknowledgement (DocuSign) from Acero committing to issue a PO within 30 days of the first invoice.
- Approval from Procurement Manager + Finance Business Partner (if exposure < $25k we can approve without VP signoff).

I can approve this conditionally if Lauren confirms that account ops can implement the invoice-only billing and monitoring. Lauren — can you implement the monitoring and stop invoices automatically if they exceed $12k? Also confirm whether accounts@acerolabs.com is acceptable for remittance or if we need a separate billing contact.

Markus
Head of Procurement
Redwood Inference

Thanks Markus. We can create a temporary invoice bucket for Acero and tag all pilot charges to a monitored code. Ops can trigger an auto-suspend at $11,900 and notify procurement/Connor. We’ll require invoices to be submitted to billing@redwood.com with Acero's account reference and a copy to accounts@acerolabs.com for transparency.

Two items: we need a billing contact and confirmation of the PO owner at Acero so we can cross-check once the PO arrives. Also recommend a clause in the DocuSign acknowledgement: if PO is not provided within 30 days, Redwood reserves the right to pause access and seek collections for outstanding invoices. I can draft a one-page acknowledgement and a short internal checklist for onboarding.

Lauren Bishop

Redwood Inference
